data.description:
Pre-existing early-return, but TB-33 now gives it a disclosure to throw on the floor.

WHERE: toolbench/passive.py:418-428.

WHAT: when reducer.calls_joined == 0, main prints "toolbench.passive: no sessions matched the given selection." (plus a skip tally when skips is non-empty) and returns 0 BEFORE render_report is ever called.

By that point the run has already built a full AgentCensus: census.totals (per-agent archive sizes), census.archive_total and census.residual are all in hand -- on a representative run, 8 agents and ~11,976 archive sessions. All of it is discarded unprinted.

WHY IT MATTERS: a user who scopes a window too narrowly is told "nothing matched" and cannot distinguish (a) an empty archive from (b) an archive holding 11,976 sessions that this window simply failed to reach. That is exactly the silence TB-33 exists to break -- and the zero-result case is where the denominator matters MOST, yet it is the one case that never prints one.

FIX SKETCH: before the early return, emit the census the run already computed -- archive_total, per-agent totals, and the unreached-agents line that _sampling_notes (toolbench/report.py:91-101) already knows how to render. Either render a census-only report, or thread the totals into the no-match message.

NOTE: several tests pin the current message (tests/test_passive_cli.py:274,283,304,352; tests/test_hermes.py:425; tests/test_sources.py:607) -- they assert substring "no sessions matched", so an ADDITIVE census suffix should keep them green.
data.title: calls_joined == 0 early-return discards the census: 'no sessions matched' throws away a denominator it already computed

data.body: Delegator complete. PR #60 (open, mergeable): https://github.com/mrojas54/tool-benchmarks/pull/60. Branch fix/tb-34-zero-match-census-disclosure off origin/main@d94b75f. Reused report._sampling_notes (the same helper render_report already calls) to append an additive census disclosure to the zero-match message -- never replaces the original string, so the existing substring-pinning tests in test_passive_cli.py/test_hermes.py/test_sources.py needed no changes. Extended SPEC S35 in place (already covered the empty-selection message's typed skip tally; no separate census/sampling criterion existed for TB-33 to have extended) and its EVALUATION row. Added ZeroMatchCensusDisclosureTests (2 tests: unreached-agent disclosure, unenumerated-residual disclosure). Quality gate: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (0 errors), pytest 580 passed/2 skipped/3 subtests (+2 from baseline 578). Scope confirmed: only the calls_joined==0 block in passive.py touched; freeze-replay branch (TB-37's territory) untouched. .lattice/ untouched.

CORRECTION (appended, not a rewrite — the event log is append-only).

The completion comment above records this ticket's branch as being off
`origin/main@d94b75f`. That is wrong. Verified against git:
`TB-34`'s branch was cut from **`2e83ebf`**, one `.lattice`-only
bookkeeping commit later than `d94b75f`.

Cause: the base was transcribed from the dispatch prompt's intent rather than
read back from git at worktree-creation time. Impact was limited to diff/
conflict triage guidance (the merges themselves were unaffected and all four
tickets merged clean). Corrected in `.lattice/orchestration/agents.md`, which
now carries the per-branch bases as verified by `git merge-base`.
